auth.subtitle: Your team’s passwords, on your phone

noWorkspace.title: No workspace yet
noWorkspace.description: Your account isn’t in a WeldSuite workspace. Create one on the web, or ask to be invited, then check again.

lock.title: WeldPass is locked
lock.noScreenLockDescription: WeldPass keeps your passwords behind your phone’s screen lock. Set a passcode, PIN or pattern in Settings, then come back.

items.title: Passwords
items.emptyDescription: Add a login, a secure note or a card. It’s saved in your personal vault unless you pick a shared one.
items.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or filter.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.personalDescription: Only you can see this vault.
vaults.emptyDescription: Your personal vault appears here once WeldPass has set it up.
vaults.noItemsDescription: Items added here are shared with everyone in the vault.
vaults.readOnly: You can view this vault, not change it.
vaults.notMember: As a workspace admin you can manage who has access to this vault, but you can’t see the passwords in it. Add yourself as a member to open them.
vaults.notMemberTitle: You’re not a member of this vault

item.copiedSecret: {field} copied. It’s cleared from the clipboard in 30 seconds.
item.deleteMessage: This removes the item for everyone who can see it in this vault. This cannot be undone.
item.auditNote: Revealing or copying a secret is recorded in the vault activity.

form.title: Title
form.totpHelp: Paste the setup key (base32) or the otpauth:// link from the site.
form.appsHelp: Package names, one per line (e.g. com.example.app). Your Android phone offers this login in those apps.
form.noWritableVault: You can’t add items to any vault.
form.fromAutofill: Save the login you just used
form.addDescription: Choose what to store and where to keep it.
form.editDescription: Saving replaces the item and keeps the earlier version in its history.
form.typeLocked: The type can’t be changed after creating the item.
form.sharedVaultHint: Everyone in this vault will be able to see this item.

generator.title: Generator
generator.hint: Look-alike characters (l, 1, I, O, 0) are left out, so it can be read out or typed from a screen.

health.title: Password health
health.fixHint: Weakest first. Open a login to change its password.
health.emptyDescription: Add logins with a password and they will be checked here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineFooter: An encrypted copy of the vaults you can open, so WeldPass works without a connection. Changes need a connection.
settings.offlineUnavailable: Needs Face ID, Touch ID or a fingerprint set up on this phone.
settings.offlineDisabled: Your workspace has turned offline copies off.
settings.offlineRevoked: This phone’s copy was removed. Turn it on again to keep a copy here.
settings.offlineOff: This server doesn’t keep offline copies.
settings.removeDeviceMessage: Its offline copy is wiped the next time it connects.
settings.autofillOn: WeldPass fills in passwords in apps and websites.
settings.autofillOff: Turn on WeldPass in the phone’s autofill settings to fill in passwords in apps and websites.
settings.autofillNeedsCopy: Autofill reads the offline copy, so it needs one on this phone.
settings.lockAlwaysOn: Always on. WeldPass asks again after a minute in the background, and before it shows or copies a password.
settings.signOutMessage: You need to sign in again to see your vaults on this phone.

errors.offline: You’re offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to do this. Ask the vault’s manager.
errors.viewerOnly: You can view this vault, not change it.
errors.notFound: This item or vault no longer exists.
errors.crypto: WeldPass can’t open vaults on this server right now. Ask your administrator to check the WeldPass key.

autofill.noCopy: Open WeldPass and unlock it once, then it can fill in here.
